name: Somnath Temple, Prabhas Patan
path: Somnath Temple, Prabhas Patan, Gir Somnath, India
summary: The first of the twelve sacred Shiva Jyotirlingas, overlooking the Arabian Sea.
points: Reconstructed in 1951 CE in classical Chaulukya (Solanki) style initiated by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
Solanki dynasty heritage with modern national reconstruction
Stands at the ancient Triveni Sangam (confluence of Kapila, Hiran, and Saraswati rivers)

name: Statue of Unity, Kevadia
path: Statue of Unity, Kevadia, Narmada, India
summary: The world's tallest statue standing 182 meters high, honoring Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
points: Inaugurated on 31 October 2018; designed by Padma Bhushan sculptor Ram V. Sutar
Commemorates Iron Man of India Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel who unified 562 princely states
Stands on Sadhu Bet island facing the Sardar Sarovar Dam on the Narmada River
